verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a structured PR summary generated from full-codebase context to orient reviewers (qodo-docs-22). Its docs also say it reviews every connected PR automatically, with configurable automatic or manual triggers (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26). Missing for 10: an explicit per-file change walkthrough (the summary snippet is truncated and never names a file-by-file walkthrough), clear confirmation that the summary itself posts automatically on every PR rather than only the review findings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
